title: Python ML: Linear Regression
description: Linear regression uses the relationship between data points to draw a straight line through all them. This line can be used to predict future values. In Python, typically 'scipy.stats' is used to find the relationship (coefficient) and 'matplotlib' is used to visualize the trend line.
example:
# Linear Regression Implementation
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

x = [5,7,8,7,2,17,2,9,4,11,12,9,6]
y = [99,86,87,88,111,86,103,87,94,78,77,85,86]

slope, intercept, r, p, std_err = stats.linregress(x, y)

def myfunc(x):
  return slope * x + intercept

mymodel = list(map(myfunc, x))
plt.scatter(x, y)
plt.plot(x, mymodel)
plt.show()
